name: rainbow_hc
note: A continuous rainbow: cold green, mid yellow, hot red, sweeping through every hue between along the OKLCh hue arc with chroma as high as sRGB allows (docs/PLAN.md M5). The owner tunes hues and stop positions by eye; the order stays green, yellow, red. saturation: pixels at the camera's clip. lockedAbove / lockedBelow: with the range locked, pixels above and below it (grey, as Xtherm; the owner, 2026-09-26).
